propositions: Core implements five CAS retry cycles plus exactly one conditional terminal push, with strict delivery raising PushDeliveryError and best-effort returning None by default.

Strict delivery is opt-in and additive via keyword-only strict=False parameter; all existing callers (event append, batch append, import, close, delete, compact, claim) preserve best-effort behavior without modification.
Python module adapter translates PushDeliveryError to stderr and nonzero exit; strict failures emit no ticket event or BRIDGE_ALERT and preserve working-tree state.
Eleven stable rejection reasons distinguish policy declines from transport failures and cover all early-return and terminal branches with git detail and unpushed-commit count.
Dirty-tree staging and committing remain outside push_tickets_branch and are owned by dependent workflows; no persisted schema or existing environment contract changed.
